defs.d: A wheeled vehicle that moves independently, with at least three wheels, powered mechanically, steered by a driver and mostly for personal transportation.
defs.ex: She drove her car to the mall.

defs.d: A wheeled vehicle, drawn by a horse or other animal; a chariot.
A group, collection, category or set sharing characteristics or attributes.
defs.ex: Often used to imply membership of a large class.

defs.d: A social grouping, based on job, wealth, etc. In Britain, society is commonly split into three main classes; upper class, middle class and working class.
To assign to a class; to classify.
defs.ex: I would class this with most of the other mediocre works of the period.

defs.d: To be grouped or classed.
Great; fabulous
The act of going.
A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
defs.ex: It’s your go.

defs.d: To move:
(chiefly of a machine) To work or function (properly); to move or perform (as required).
defs.ex: The engine just won't go anymore.

defs.d: Working correctly and ready to commence operation; approved and able to be put into action.
To be, or act as, a grandfather to.
To retain discontinued laws or rules for (a thing, person or organization previously affected by them).
The parent of someone's parent
The state of being free from physical or psychological disease, illness, or malfunction; wellness.
defs.ex: Her mental health is really affected by stressful environments.

defs.d: A state of well-being or balance, often physical but sometimes also mental and social; the overall level of function of an organism from the cellular (micro) level to the social (macro) level.
defs.ex: The directors are concerned about the financial health of the project.

defs.d: Activity for amusement only, especially among the young.
defs.ex: Children learn through play.

defs.d: Similar activity in young animals, as they explore their environment and learn new skills.
defs.ex: This kind of play helps the young lion cubs develop their hunting skills.

defs.d: To act in a manner such that one has fun; to engage in activities expressly for the purpose of recreation or entertainment.
defs.ex: They played long and hard.

defs.d: To perform in (a sport); to participate in (a game).
defs.ex: He plays on three teams

defs.d: A passage in text that is about a different subject from the preceding text, marked by commencing on a new line, the first line sometimes being indented.
A mark or note set in the margin to call attention to something in the text, such as a change of subject.
To sort text into paragraphs.
Any one out of an indefinite number of persons; anyone; any person.
defs.ex: Anybody will do.

defs.d: A person of some consideration or standing.
defs.ex: Everybody who wants to be anybody will come to Jake's party.

defs.d: The state of being an employee; employment.
defs.ex: The school district has six thousand teachers in its employ.

defs.d: The act of employing someone or making use of something; employment.
To hire (somebody for work or a job).
defs.ex: Yesterday our local garage employed a new mechanic.

defs.d: To use (somebody for a job, or something for a task).
defs.ex: The burglar employed a jemmy to get in.

defs.d: An attempt to find something.
defs.ex: With only five minutes until we were meant to leave, the search for the keys started in earnest.

defs.d: The act of searching in general.
defs.ex: Search is a hard problem for computers to solve efficiently.

defs.d: To look in (a place) for something.
defs.ex: I searched the garden for the keys and found them in the vegetable patch.

defs.d: (followed by "for") To look thoroughly.
defs.ex: The police are searching for evidence in his flat.

defs.d: A subject of a nation.
defs.ex: The diplomats were advised not to interact with any foreign nationals except on official duty.

defs.d: (usually in the plural) A tournament in which participants from all over the nation compete.
defs.ex: After winning the regional tournament, the team advanced to the nationals.

defs.d: Of or having to do with a nation.
(by extension) Of or having to do with a country (sovereign state).
defs.ex: Import tariffs were raised for the national interest.

defs.d: To promote or advantage.
To move forward in space or time.
At or close to the state of the art.
Enhanced.
To cause (someone) to feel unusually alarmed or delighted by something unexpected.
defs.ex: It surprises me that I owe twice as much as I thought I did.

defs.d: To do something to (a person) that they are not expecting, as a surprise.
defs.ex: He doesn’t know that I’m in the country – I thought I’d turn up at his house and surprise him.

defs.d: A situation in which somebody is surprised.
Causing surprise.
defs.ex: A surprising number of people attended the rally.

defs.d: A substance that is in a condensed form.
To bring to, or direct toward, a common center; to unite more closely; to gather into one body, mass, or force.
defs.ex: to concentrate rays of light into a focus

defs.d: To increase the strength and diminish the bulk of, as of a liquid or an ore; to intensify, by getting rid of useless material; to condense.
defs.ex: to concentrate acid by evaporation

defs.d: A three-dimensional work of art, usually representing a person or animal, usually created by sculpting, carving, molding, or casting.
A portrait.
To form a statue of; to make into a statue.
To make (someone) aware of (something impending); especially:
To caution or admonish (someone) against unwise or unacceptable behaviour.
defs.ex: Don't let me catch you running in the corridor again, I warn you.

defs.d: The action of the verb warn; an instance of warning someone.
Something spoken or written that is intended to warn.
defs.ex: The boss gave him a warning that he would be fired if he did not desist from his behaviour.

defs.d: Used to warn of danger in signs and notices.
A biological organ of vertebrates that controls breathing and oxygenates the blood.
(plural) Capacity for exercise or exertion; breath.
defs.ex: He hasn't the lungs to play long rallies like he use to.

defs.d: A beginning; a first move.
A new development; a fresh approach to something; a new way of dealing with a problem.
Serving to initiate; inceptive; initiatory; introductory; preliminary.
In which voter initiatives can be brought to the ballot.
To notice or view, especially carefully or with attention to detail.
defs.ex: From this vantage point we can observe the behavior of the animals in their natural habitat.

defs.d: To follow or obey the custom, practice, or rules (especially of a religion).
defs.ex: Please observe all posted speed limits.

defs.d: The act of offending:
The state of being offended or displeased; anger; displeasure.
To attempt to stop the progression of; to resist or antagonize by physical means, or by arguments, etc.; to contend against.
defs.ex: There is still time to oppose this plan.

defs.d: To object to.
defs.ex: Many religious leaders oppose cloning humans.

defs.d: Recovery.
A position of holding a firearm during exercises, whereby the lock is at shoulder height and the sling facing out.
To get back, to regain (a physical thing; in astronomy and navigation, sight of a thing or a signal).
defs.ex: After days of inquiries, he finally recovered his lost wallet.

defs.d: To salvage, to extricate, to rescue (a thing or person)
defs.ex: They recovered three of the explorers very much alive, then another, wracked with severe hypothermia, who was taken to hospital.

defs.d: To wish, desire.
To instruct (that something be done) in one's will.
The execution of a will.
Ready to do something that is not (can't be expected as) a matter of course.
defs.ex: If my boyfriend isn't willing to change his drinking habits, I will split up with him.
